versions.changelog:
Initial release of agentmemory-hooks – automatic memory capture plugin hooks.

- Registers lifecycle hooks to capture observations automatically during agent sessions.
- No need for manual `memory_save`; tool use, prompts, and session events are recorded by default.
- Zero-LLM by default; optional LLM-based summarizing and context injection.
- Includes troubleshooting steps and related skills for configuration and consumption.
- Observations can be monitored in real time at `http://localhost:3113`.
